semiconductor_relevance: High — FST International H.C., Ltd. provides specialized equipment for semiconductor manufacturing processes, particularly in monitoring and control systems.
summary: FST International H.C., Ltd. specializes in equipment for semiconductor and related electronic businesses, offering advanced monitoring solutions for chemical mechanical polishing (CMP) processes and environmental control systems. Their products are utilized by major semiconductor fabs for precise measurement and contamination control.
